newsitem.title: UK: UK's Grantchester acquires warehouse space.
newsitem.headline: UK's Grantchester acquires warehouse space.

text.p: British retail housing group, Grantchester Holdings Plc, said on Wednesday it was securing more than 260,000 square feet of new and existing retail warehouse space for 35 million stg.

It said the purchases had been made on average yields of close to seven percent with average rents on the properties standing at 9.19 stg per square foot with projected annual rental income exceeding 2.4 million stg.
The deals will see the group expanding its geographical spread into the South West and Wales.
The acquisitions will take Grantchester's total retail warehouse portfolio to over 1.75 million square feet on 22 schemes throughout the UK.
Grantchester's share price closed at 150 pence on Tuesday.
